name: Microsoft Agent Framework
description: The unified successor that merges AutoGen and Semantic Kernel; reached 1.0 GA in April 2026.
descriptionZh: 合并 AutoGen 与 Semantic Kernel 的统一框架；2026 年 4 月达到 1.0 GA。
keyFact: Microsoft Agent Framework reached 1.0 GA in April 2026 and is the merger of Microsoft's AutoGen and Semantic Kernel projects, both of which then moved into maintenance mode.
keyFactZh: Microsoft Agent Framework 于 2026 年 4 月达到 1.0 GA，是微软 AutoGen 与 Semantic Kernel 两个项目的合并体，二者随后进入维护模式。
